evidence.title: Khroma - AI Color Tool for Designers | Discover and Save Color Palettes

name: Khroma
summary: AI color tool that learns which colors you like and generates palettes you can search, preview and save.
description: Khroma trains an in-browser neural network on the colors you pick, then generates unlimited palettes you can view as typography, gradient, palette or custom image. Palettes are searchable and filterable by hue, tint, value and hex/rgb values, and saveable to a collection with color names, hex, rgb, CSS and WCAG contrast ratings.
contains: personalized palette generator trained on your color choices in the browser
palette previews as typography, gradient, palette or custom image
search and filter the generator by hue, tint, value, color, hex and rgb
unlimited saved collection with color names, hex, rgb, CSS code and WCAG accessibility rating
made by George Hastings; Instagram inspiration via @khromacolors
